Final capture uses the locked 80mm at f/4; the quoted focal lengths are reference only.
“Camera: 90mm macro at f/4 for a single hero item or 50mm at f/5.6 for a table; camera at 30–45° above the table (never 90° top-down unless the world is brutal), tripod.”

Composition leaves clean negative space in the upper-left third for a headline.
